# Furkan Bekdemir

> Psychiatry resident and computational psychiatry researcher at Ondokuz Mayıs University, Samsun. Belief updating, sensory attenuation, and instrumentation for psychiatric research.

ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-7236-5776
Code: https://github.com/frknbkdmr
Full text of every page: https://furkanbekdemir.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [Furkan Bekdemir](https://furkanbekdemir.com/): Psychiatry resident and computational psychiatry researcher at Ondokuz Mayıs University.
- [Research](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/): Belief updating and sensory attenuation in schizophrenia, akathisia as active inference, effort-based decision making in multiple sclerosis, and uncertainty processing in generalized anxiety disorder.
- [Akathisia as active inference](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/akathisia): An active inference account of akathisia, locating the disorder in how bodily prediction errors are turned into action rather than in the motor system. Concept note in preparation.
- [State anxiety and uncertainty processing in generalized anxiety disorder](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/anxiety-hgf): A Hierarchical Gaussian Filter study of belief updating in generalized anxiety disorder. Published abstract, Turkish Journal of Psychiatry, 2026.
- [Effort and reward in multiple sclerosis](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/effort-ms): Separating fatigue from depression in multiple sclerosis by modelling effort-based decisions, with the Department of Neurology.
- [Personality, impulsivity and gambling-related cognitions in gambling disorder](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/gambling): A clinical study of personality traits, impulsivity and gambling-related cognitions in patients with gambling disorder. Published abstract, Turkish Journal of Psychiatry, 2025.
- [Belief updating and sensory attenuation in schizophrenia](https://furkanbekdemir.com/research/schizophrenia): Residency thesis testing two accounts of delusion in the same participants: belief revision on too little evidence, and failure to attenuate self-generated sensation.
- [Instruments and code](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools): Behavioural paradigms, hardware, and analysis code built for psychiatric research: force-matching devices, beads tasks, and HGF modelling.
- [Beads task](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/beads-task): A PsychoPy implementation of the beads task that logs every draw, written so the data can be modelled rather than reduced to draws-to-decision.
- [Force-matching device](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/force-matching): A two-channel force transducer rig built in-house for the force-matching task, because no manufacturer sells one and the experiment cannot be run without it.
- [GÖRÜNGÜ](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/gorungu): Optical mark recognition and automatic scoring for paper psychiatric assessment forms, so that scale batteries stop being typed in by hand. Python, OpenCV, MIT.
- [HGF analysis pipeline](https://furkanbekdemir.com/tools/hgf-pipeline): Model fitting, parameter and model recovery, and Bayesian model selection with TAPAS, with the recovery simulations run before any participant was seen.
- [CV](https://furkanbekdemir.com/cv): Curriculum vitae of Furkan Bekdemir, MD, psychiatry resident and computational psychiatry researcher at Ondokuz Mayıs University, Samsun.
- [Notlar](https://furkanbekdemir.com/notlar): Hesaplamalı psikiyatri, kestirimsel işlemleme ve klinik akıl yürütme üzerine Türkçe notlar.
